about: Staff and About directory data (Nov. 3, 2026). Every field comes from the live GatorBait site: the Wix Members profiles (nickname, title, photo, slug), the existing /about page copy and photos, the site RSS description, and each author's published posts from the Wix Blog API (posts query by memberId). Nothing here is invented. A null means the site has no verified value; see deploy/staff-20261103/README.md for the missing-bio list.
